highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: It adds variable and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and updates every bundled native dependency. This is a breaking release with several v4 API and behavioral changes — check the notes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, loses value-equality
breaking.body: The property is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the type no longer implements IEquatable or the == / != operators. Update any code that compares instances with equality operators or expects the old type name.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is now get-only
breaking.body: The protected setter was removed. Subclasses that assigned this property must set it another way (e.g. via constructor logic) or drop the assignment if it's no longer needed.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default
breaking.body: new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you assign a typeface. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) and check Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font for drawing, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use Typeface.IsEmpty instead.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default for an unmatched family, matching non-Android behavior. For a strict null check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily instead.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null
breaking.body: Default resolution moved to the font manager; Android API 36+ now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing. No migration needed unless you relied on it being null.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The underlying native offset is a 32-bit int; out-of-range values used to silently truncate and now throw OverflowException. Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (unrecoverable process termination, not an exception) if the instance or GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion isn't declared as 1.1+. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to Vulkan 1.1 explicitly; 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in their place. There is no replacement for instance/device ownership tracking.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed
breaking.body: A new Components field (and GRVkYcbcrComponents struct) was added, changing the struct's layout. Code that manually constructs or relies on the layout of this struct must account for the new field.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine through milestones 132, 133, and 147 up to the final m148, plus follow-up upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix merges.

bullets.lead: Variable and color fonts, plus new HarfBuzzSharp APIs
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette support, an HBColor value type, and fixes several HarfBuzzSharp naming-convention violations and missing wrappers.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.
Adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and promotes remaining legacy paint text/font-reading members and pre-v4 obsoletes to compiler errors.

Fixes SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan to use RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for offsets, fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when SKPathBuilder is collected first, and moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer.

Fixes SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI TabBar, corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers.
Reworks the lifecycle of singleton instances and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and Tizen native asset support
bullets.detail: Adds Linux Bionic native assets and Tizen x64/arm64 native build support, and enables TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding to catch regressions earlier.
Updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0, FreeType to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, expat to 2.8.1/2.7.5, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and libpng to 1.6.58.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Drove much of the v4 work — the singleton lifecycle rework, variable/color font support, the SKPath finalizer fix, obsolete promotions, and numerous CI and build-chain fixes
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp support for C# 13 on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Fixed Apple platform TFMs for libraries and apps
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Bumped SkiaSharpGenerator to CppAst 0.21.4 and made it work on Linux
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI TabBar

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 stabilized the v4 API surface and behavioral changes ahead of the first stable v4 release.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), and further font and lifecycle fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added variable and color font support along with new HarfBuzzSharp APIs.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia milestone bump and the singleton lifecycle rework.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0 and adds variable font support, color font palettes, an HBColor value type, and fixes to naming-convention violations and missing API wrappers.
